attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Minnesota state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per MN tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Minnesota Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.state_tax_liability xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly

action_details.action_comment: Calculate MN tax for Single filers using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.mn_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max dup /mn_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /mn_tax xdef
mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_1_limit_single min result.mn_bracket_1_rate mul /mn_tax xdef
mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_1_limit_single gt { mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_2_limit_single min result.mn_bracket_1_limit_single sub result.mn_bracket_2_rate mul mn_tax add /mn_tax xdef } if
mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_2_limit_single gt { mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_3_limit_single min result.mn_bracket_2_limit_single sub result.mn_bracket_3_rate mul mn_tax add /mn_tax xdef } if
mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_3_limit_single gt { mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_3_limit_single sub result.mn_bracket_4_rate mul mn_tax add /mn_tax xdef } if
mn_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Minnesota tax calculated (Single): $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate MN tax for Married Filing Jointly using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.mn_standard_deduction_joint sub 0 max dup /mn_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /mn_tax xdef
mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_1_limit_joint min result.mn_bracket_1_rate mul /mn_tax xdef
mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_1_limit_joint gt { mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_2_limit_joint min result.mn_bracket_1_limit_joint sub result.mn_bracket_2_rate mul mn_tax add /mn_tax xdef } if
mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_2_limit_joint gt { mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_3_limit_joint min result.mn_bracket_2_limit_joint sub result.mn_bracket_3_rate mul mn_tax add /mn_tax xdef } if
mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_3_limit_joint gt { mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_3_limit_joint sub result.mn_bracket_4_rate mul mn_tax add /mn_tax xdef } if
mn_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Minnesota tax calculated (MFJ): $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Minnesota military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Also offers tax credits for combat zone service. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per MN Stat. § 290.032 (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Minnesota Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.mn_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0 /result.mn_sbp_exclusion xdef
initial_action.action_comment: Initialize Minnesota military retirement exclusion calculation

action_details.action_comment: Apply full exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay /result.mn_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
taxpayer.sbp_payments 0 gt { taxpayer.sbp_payments /result.mn_sbp_exclusion xdef } if
result.mn_military_retirement_exclusion result.mn_sbp_exclusion add /result.mn_total_military_exclusion xdef
result.agi result.mn_total_military_exclusion sub 0 max /result.mn_adjusted_agi xdef
"Minnesota military retirement exclusion: $" result.mn_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.mn_sbp_exclusion 0 gt { "Minnesota SBP exclusion: $" result.mn_sbp_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if "Minnesota total military exclusion: $" result.mn_total_military_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
